title: Scaling the Waiver Share Within the Partial Band — Benefit Overpayment Accounts Schedule
content:
On Benefit Overpayment Accounts, the waiver share with its points is scaled by where the household income percent falls within the partial band. The household income percent is the annual household income on the request divided by the poverty guideline for the household size on the request, times one hundred, rounded to two decimals. The band midpoint is half of the sum of the classification's full-waiver percent and partial-waiver percent.

| Household income percent | The waiver share, with any points added to it, is |
|---|---|
| Above the full-waiver percent and at or below the band midpoint | Multiplied by 1.2, the lower-band multiplier |
| Above the band midpoint and at or below the partial-waiver percent | Multiplied by 0.8, the upper-band multiplier |
| Any other percent | Left unscaled |

## The band by classification

| Classification | Full-waiver percent | Partial-waiver percent | Band midpoint | Lower band | Upper band |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Agency Error | 200 | 250 | 225 | above 200 up to 225 | above 225 up to 250 |
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Employer Reporting Error | 200 | 250 | 225 | above 200 up to 225 | above 225 up to 250 |
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Appeal Reversal | 200 | 250 | 225 | above 200 up to 225 | above 225 up to 250 |
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Claimant Error | 0 | 0 | 0 | none | none |
| Fraud Overpayment — First Offense | 0 | 0 | 0 | none | none |
| Fraud Overpayment — Repeat Offense | 0 | 0 | 0 | none | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical percents, waiver-eligible classification)

| Income percent | Multiplier | A share of 0.65 becomes |
|---|---|---|
| 200.00 | None (not above 200) | 0.65 |
| 200.01 | 1.2 | 0.78 |
| 225.00 | 1.2 | 0.78 |
| 225.01 | 0.8 | 0.52 |
| 250.00 | 0.8 | 0.52 |
| 250.01 | None | 0.65 |
